notes: Model call 1 had 0 cached tokens (first coach call of the day for the Standard prompt: cold cache); calls 2-3 reused about 96-97% of the prompt from the cache.
Tool results are stored truncated to 400 characters by agents.py; these were short enough to be complete.
The tool calls 'final_result' is PydanticAI's structured-output call; it is not counted in tool_calls (2).

Quality slip visible in this real run: the issue text says 'Insert the LF Closed Change?' while the fix id is sw_rf_change (the RF Closed Change), which is the correct bridge. The output validator checks ids, verdict and dance, not the wording, so the wrong label got through. Worth naming under agent malfunction / limits.
